title: Prime Fall T-4 — inventory 84% · deals 100% · creative 60%
narrative: Inventory goes first because the FBA cutoff does not move. Everything downstream of it can wait a few hours; freight cannot.
status_note: Execute · 0 of 5 · freight first, the cutoff does not move

plan.name: Inventory · air freight and transfers
plan.meta: tendered before the FBA cutoff · 31 hours of margin, not 31 days

items.name: Air freight tendered · 2 lanes
items.detail: 360 units of Dutch Oven and 180 of Sauté Pan booked on Aug 20 departures, arriving Aug 22 — one day before the window opens.

items.name: West-node transfer created
items.detail: 140 units moved to the East node for $340 of freight, covering the balance of the Sauté Pan gap without air.

items.name: Event cover recalculated
items.detail: All 14 event SKUs now clear P50 cover for the full 96 hours. Two clear P90 as well; the rest are a P50 plan by design.

plan.name: Ads · budgets staged and armed
plan.meta: $52K across four channels · arms at T-0, not now

items.name: Event budgets staged
items.detail: Amazon $28K, Google $11K, Meta $8K, TikTok $5K — written to each platform as scheduled changes that take effect at 00:01 on Aug 23.

items.name: Pacing authority armed at Assist
items.detail: Budget may move between armed campaigns while mROAS holds above 1.4×, up to the +180% daily cap. New campaigns and new creative still ask.

items.name: Creative fatigue watch to hourly
items.detail: Frequency and CTR decay checked hourly rather than daily. In a 96-hour window, a daily check is two data points.

plan.name: Creative and listings
plan.meta: reduced DTC lineup · canonical check re-run on all 14 event listings

items.name: DTC lineup reduced to what exists
items.detail: Two email sends and five social variants instead of three and eight. Costs about $6K of the $48K DTC forecast, and the send calendar is rebuilt around what is real.

items.name: Event listings verified against canonical
items.detail: All 14 passed the 10.5 field-level check this morning, and the fast-lane monitor cadence holds through the window — a hero image drifting during Prime Fall is a different kind of expensive.

items.name: Deal badges and A+ scheduled
items.detail: Amazon and Walmart deal imagery scheduled to publish at 00:01 and revert at expiry, so nothing advertises a price that has ended.

plan.name: Fulfilment and account health
plan.meta: handling buffer armed for the window · hourly metric polling

items.name: Handling-time buffer armed
items.detail: +1 day on East-node SKUs from Aug 23 to Aug 27. Costs roughly $4.2K of revenue in conversion and keeps late shipment under 4% through the Monday that broke last BFCM.

items.name: Account metrics to hourly polling
items.detail: Late shipment, ODR and cancellation checked hourly with a 0.3pp pre-alarm, which is tighter than the marketplace threshold on purpose.

items.name: 3PL notified with the volume forecast
items.detail: P50 and P90 daily order counts sent to both nodes, with the Monday peak called out explicitly rather than left in a spreadsheet.

plan.name: Cash and monitoring
plan.meta: credit line pre-arranged · war room and post-event readout scheduled

items.name: Credit line pre-arranged
items.detail: $60K available on demand at 9.4% for the sixteen days of settlement lag. About $470 of interest, drawn only if the trough needs it.

items.name: War room opens at T-0
items.detail: Pacing tiles per lens go live at 00:01 with in-flight adjustment cards labelled by authority level, so nobody has to guess whether Realify acted or asked.

items.name: Post-event readout scheduled
items.detail: Incrementality measured at +14 days against the post-event trough, not against the week before. Learnings annotate to the Ledger for next year’s T-8 card.
